info.name: Colliding Balls
info.description: Interactive elastic N-ball physics simulation with mass-based collisions, a mouse-controlled blue user ball, border bounces, and reactive procedural GPU sound.

renderpass.name: Common
renderpass.description: Shared simulation parameters and 2D mass-based elastic collision math.

renderpass.name: Buffer A
renderpass.description: Stateful simulation of N bouncing balls, mouse-controlled blue user ball, collision detection, and audio event timestamps.

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.description: Renders the arena, blue mouse-controlled user ball, and N colliding balls with hit flashes.

renderpass.name: Sound
renderpass.description: Emits stereo-panned percussive sounds on ball-ball and ball-border collisions.
